StukovFetidTouch.name: Fetid Touch
StukovFetidTouch.description: Basic Attacks become ranged and Slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 seconds, but deal 35% less damage. This effect can be toggled. Quest: Hit Heroes with Weighted Pustule. Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Weighted Pustule by 5 seconds and remove its Mana cost.

StukovLowBlow.name: Low Blow
StukovLowBlow.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

StukovWeightedPustuleReactiveBallistospo.name: Reactive Ballistospores
StukovWeightedPustuleReactiveBallistospo.description: While below 50% Health, the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch refreshes 100% faster. Activate to instantly spread a Weighted Pustule to all nearby enemy Heroes and reset the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch. This effect has a 75 second cooldown.

StukovOneGoodSpread.name: One Good Spread...
StukovOneGoodSpread.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

StukovBioticArmor.name: Biotic Armor
StukovBioticArmor.description: Healing Pathogen grants 10 Physical Armor to targets while active on them. Detonating Bio-Kill Switch increases this bonus to 50 for 2.5 seconds.

StukovVigorousReuptake.name: Vigorous Reuptake
StukovVigorousReuptake.description: Bio-Kill Switch heals for 30% more when detonating 3 or more Healing Pathogens.

StukovLongPitch.name: The Long Pitch
StukovLongPitch.description: Increase the range of Weighted Pustule by 50%. Detonating 2 or more Weighted Pustules causes Stukov's Bio-Kill Switch and Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 4 seconds.

StukovGrowingInfestation.name: Growing Infestation
StukovGrowingInfestation.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

StukovTargetedExcision.name: Targeted Excision
StukovTargetedExcision.description: Detonating exactly 1 Weighted Pustule (but any number of Healing Pathogens) with Bio-Kill Switch reduces the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch to 7 seconds and other Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.

StukovHeroicAbilityFlailingSwipe.name: Flailing Swipe
StukovHeroicAbilityFlailingSwipe.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

StukovHeroicAbilityMassiveShove.name: Massive Shove
StukovHeroicAbilityMassiveShove.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

StukovItHungers.name: It Hungers
StukovItHungers.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

StukovVirulentReaction.name: Virulent Reaction
StukovVirulentReaction.description: Detonating a Weighted Pustule on an enemy who is inside of Lurking Arm Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

StukovPoppinPustules.name: Poppin' Pustules
StukovPoppinPustules.description: Detonating Weighted Pustule with Bio-Kill Switch within 1.5 seconds of its expiration increases its damage by 150% and applies its damage and Slow in an area. Enemy Heroes hit have a Weighted Pustule applied to them.

StukovSuperstrain.name: Superstrain
StukovSuperstrain.description: Whenever an ally with Healing Pathogen is Stunned or Rooted, they are instantly healed for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

StukovUniversalCarrier.name: Universal Carrier
StukovUniversalCarrier.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

StukovPoxPopuli.name: Pox Populi
StukovPoxPopuli.description: Bio-Kill Switch no longer removes Healing Pathogen but instead sets its duration to 3 seconds.

StukovControlledChaos.name: Controlled Chaos
StukovControlledChaos.description: Flailing Swipe gains 2 additional charges, but each use only swings 1 time, at maximum range. Additionally, its cooldown is decreased to 25 seconds, and its Mana cost is reduced from 60 to 25.

StukovPushComesToShove.name: Push Comes To Shove
StukovPushComesToShove.description: Massive Shove Slows its target by 50% for 4 seconds upon colliding with terrain. If Massive Shove pushes a target for more than 1.25 seconds, its cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds.

StukovTopOff.name: Top Off
StukovTopOff.description: Healing Pathogen's heal over time is increased by 30% while its target is above 60% Health.

StukovBioExplosionSwitch.name: Bio-Explosion Switch
StukovBioExplosionSwitch.description: Bio-Kill Switch now also detonates Lurking Arm, dealing 230 (+4% per level) damage, applying a Weighted Pustule, and Silencing enemy Heroes inside for 2.5 seconds.
